description: Several C# utility classes and extension methods
releaseNotes:
26.1.3.42: New Conversion.ParseEnum(value, defaultValue, definedOnly, ignoreCase = false) overload: with definedOnly, values the enum does not define return the default ([Flags] enums accept combinations of their flags). New Conversion.IsDefinedEnumValue(value). The existing ParseEnum overloads are unchanged.
		26.1.3.41: Bug fixes found by a new unit test suite (DX.Utils.Tests). Fixed: Collection.Clear() and the IList indexer setter recursed into a StackOverflow, Dispose threw on a non-empty collection; Bits.Clear always returned 0 and Has(ref, flag, clear: false) wiped the value; MimeTypes.GetMimeTypes always returned null, so lookup by name/extension/Uri never worked; MimeType rejected '(' and validates the primary type; EnumExtensions.GetDisplay no longer throws for [Display(Name)] without ResourceType, undefined values or flag combinations; Attributes.GetAttributeData honours TAttribute and GetTypesWith is thread safe; RequiredIf has the right default message, sets MemberNames and its '_' fallback is no longer inverted; StripHTMLTags removes multi-line heads, turns   into a space and keeps plain '&' text; CopyMaxLength, InsureHtmlParagraph, FormatFileSize (unit boundaries, long.MinValue) and MakeFileNameSEOSafe (names without an extension) fixed; GetConfigOption/ToDictionary no longer throw on duplicate keys; DateMin/DateMax keep DateTimeKind; GetRegExGroupValue returns the default for missing groups; Log uses a 24-hour clock and logs the exception type and message. Performance: StripHTMLTags is linear (100 KB: 1.2 s to 3 ms), MIME definitions are parsed once (about 400x faster), PropertyExtensions caches properties per type without a Task.Run per lookup, GetTypesWith caches its results and scans only assemblies loaded since the last call. Behaviour changes: PropertyExtensions ignores private properties, skips indexers and read-only destination properties; AsQueryParameters encodes values once; AppendQueryParameters keeps the existing query; StripHTMLTags keeps escaped markup (<b>) as text; DetermineMimeType/GetMimeType fall back to the file extension; GetConfigOption with duplicate keys returns the last value.
		26.1.3.40: Ported CronJobs (CronExpression/CronBuilder/CronSchedule/CronObject) from .NET Framework to
		net462/net8.0/net9.0/net10.0 (dropped the System.Web dependency, replaced Thread.Abort() with cooperative
		cancellation). Added CronJobService, a thread-safe runtime job registry (CronJobService.Default singleton,
		or services.AddCronJobService() for DI on non-Framework targets). CronObject.OnCronTrigger handlers that
		throw are now caught, logged, and raised via the new OnError event instead of silently killing the job's
		loop.
		26.1.3.39: Added MimeDetection by content.
		26.1.3.38: Added a README.md with technical documentation, now embedded in the package via PackageReadmeFile.
		26.1.3.37: Fixed IDE1005, IDE0059 and CA1304/CA1307/CA1310/CA1805-class analyzer warnings in Conversion.cs
		(simplified conditional delegate invocation, removed dead re-assignments in catch blocks, and made
		ParseBool's string comparison culture- and comparison-explicit). No behavior change.
		23.2.3.34: .NETv9 support
		23.2.3.31: Data.DataStore plus Validator and Mapper have been moved and simplified into package DX.Data
		BREAKING CHANGES:
		Data classes moved to DX.Data package
		DX.Data package refactored to use FluentValidation with simplyfied validation logic
		20.1.8.25: Upgrade to .NET 8
		20.1.8.24: static class renamed in Strings.cs
		20.1.8.22: IsCollectionProperty extension method added to fix bug in DX.Data.Xpo
		20.1.8.21: Upgrade from .NET Framework to 4.6.1 to 4.6.2
		20.1.8.20: Fix
		20.1.8.19: Small fix
		20.1.7.19: .NET 6.0 upgrade
		20.1.7.17: IDataStoreModel<TKey> not needed anymore on Models and DBModels. No ID property needed.
		20.1.7.16: Validation results include eventType (inserting, Inserted etc), Exception helper class for results, smaller fixes
		20.1.3.15: Upgrade to DX v20.1.3
		20.1.2.14-pre-20064: Upgrade to DX v20.1.2-pre-20064 and .NET preview 5
		1.0.0.14: BREAKING CHANGE: Signature-change on IDataValidator<..>.Deleting(..):
			        Was: Deleting(TKey id, object arg, IDataValidationResults<TKey> validationResults);
				    Is:  Deleting(TKey id, IDataValidationResults<TKey> validationResults, params object[] args);
		1.0.0.13: ListExtensions added
		1.0.0.12: dotnet standard 2.1 for dotnet core v3.1 support
		1.0.0.10: Small fixes and implementation of DataMapper and DataValidator
		1.0.0.8: Small refactorings to improve speed and support for Pageable (XP)DataStore
		1.0.0.7: Abstract Generic DTO DataStore and Validator classes added
		1.0.0.6: Changed .NET Framework to v4.6.1
		1.0.0.5: Initial dual mode package for .NET Framework and .NET Standard 2.0
		Some features don't work yet on .NET Standard 2.0
